mechanism: Both drugs have additive hypotensive and bradycardic effects; candesartan may potentiate metoprolol's blood pressure-lowering action through complementary mechanisms (beta-blockade vs. angiotensin II receptor antagonism).
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate regularly; dose adjustment of either agent may be necessary to avoid excessive hypotension or bradycardia; combination is commonly used therapeutically but requires clinical oversight.
